questions.subject: Logical Reasoning
questions.text:
All members of the provincial bar association are licensed advocates. Some licensed advocates are also certified mediators. No certified mediator sits on the disciplinary committee.

Which one of the following must be true?
options: No member of the provincial bar association sits on the disciplinary committee.
Some licensed advocates do not sit on the disciplinary committee.
Every certified mediator is a member of the provincial bar association.
All members of the disciplinary committee are certified mediators.
questions.explanation: Certified mediators cannot sit on the disciplinary committee, and some licensed advocates are certified mediators. Those advocates therefore cannot be on the committee, so option B must be true. Options A and D overstate the relationship, and C reverses the direction of the first statement.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Choose the word most nearly opposite in meaning to ‘candid’.
questions.explanation: ‘Candid’ means open and honest. ‘Evasive’ means deliberately avoiding a direct answer, so it is the opposite.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: If 3x + 7 = 2x + 15, what is the value of x squared?
questions.explanation: Subtract 2x and 7 from both sides: x = 8. Then x squared is 64.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: The Objectives Resolution, which later became a substantive part of the Constitution of Pakistan, was passed by the Constituent Assembly in which year?
questions.explanation: The Objectives Resolution was passed on 12 March 1949 under Prime Minister Liaquat Ali Khan.

questions.subject: Pakistan Studies
questions.text: The Lahore Resolution, demanding independent states for Muslims of South Asia, was passed in which year?
questions.explanation: The Lahore Resolution was presented at the All-India Muslim League session in Lahore in March 1940.

questions.subject: Pakistan Studies
questions.text: Pakistan’s first Constitution came into force in which year?
questions.explanation: The first Constitution was enforced on 23 March 1956; later ones followed in 1962 and 1973.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is the average of 12, 18, 24 and 30?
questions.explanation: The sum is 84; dividing by 4 numbers gives 21.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Choose the correct word to complete the sentence: Neither of the candidates ___ prepared for the interview.
questions.explanation: ‘Neither’ takes a singular verb, so ‘was’ is correct.

questions.subject: Logical Reasoning
questions.text: All roses are flowers. Some flowers fade quickly. Which conclusion must be true?
questions.explanation: Only the first statement is certain: every rose is a flower. The others cannot be concluded from the premises.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Which city was the first capital of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: Karachi was the capital from 1947 until the capital moved to Rawalpindi and then Islamabad.
